Gringo's Washboard BandElectronic Press Kit

A Gringo's Washboard Band

The music born on the banks of the Mississippi River goes beyond blues and jazz and echoes across the world of music.

That is the essence Gringo's WB brings, with a fresh outlook and its roots intact, taking the audience on a true journey to the banks of the Mississippi.

Founded in Brazil in 2013, Gringo's WB carries the spirit and history of its founders, artists who helped shape the music as it is today.

With energy, charisma and flawless performances, the band has established itself as a unique name on the Portuguese music scene.

History

Born in Brazil in 2013, Gringo's WB has a solid track record and extensive stage experience.

The band has played many jazz and blues festivals across South America and gained massive exposure in 2016 when it stood out on Superstar on Rede Globo, along with several other appearances on Brazilian television.

In Portugal, the group consolidated its success by winning the Portugal Blues Challenge in 2023 and shining as a Got Talent Portugal semi-finalist in 2026 — achievements that brought it huge visibility and recognition across the country.

Root of the Oppressed

The Root of the Oppressed show is an immersion in the neglected narratives of African American music. Far from commercial clichés, the concert brings to light the harshness of racial segregation, misogyny and slavery-like labour, historical realities that still echo in today's society.

Under the Gringo's WB signature, blues and contemporary vocal jazz blend with ragtime, country blues and folk in a minimalist approach. The project's sound breaks with tradition by leaving out the drums and putting the washboard at the rhythmic heart and centre stage, sharing the front of the stage with the voice.

Through contrast, irony and drama, the songs are meticulously reinvented. The repertoire travels from the pioneering work of Ida Cox and Bessie Smith, who broke gender paradigms, to the deep melancholy of Charley Patton and Rev. Gary Davis. A performance of strong human connection and stage energy, made to be a cornerstone for music lovers.
